chemistry_notes: Electrophilic aromatic nitration is highly exothermic. Flow chemistry provides superior heat transfer (Da_th = 0.0016) and mixing control. Dinitration requires precise residence time to avoid over-oxidation. Nitric acid is corrosive; PFA tubing is recommended over FEP for better chemical resistance at 60 C, though FEP is acceptable. No light source needed. BPR not strictly required by calculation but recommended for safety and pressure stability.
